answers.answer: Crafted, authoring-time link phrases provide the densest, most context-specific characterization because each phrase explains why the target matters within its surrounding argument. Their availability is unreliable because they require human judgment and authoring discipline; if no one writes the contextual link phrase, the pointer is absent.

The four forms are natural-language, symbolic, distributed-parametric, and mixed. Representational form describes how an artifact’s operative part is encoded and consumed, whereas storage substrate describes where or in what container it is stored. For example, Markdown can contain natural-language, symbolic, or mixed content, while a vector store can expose natural-language records whose retrieval depends on distributed-parametric embeddings.

The best configuration—subtask-level tips with LLM-guided retrieval—reported a 14.3-percentage-point improvement in scenario goal completion on held-out AppWorld tasks. The KB analysis identifies oracle dependency as the key limitation: learning relies on AppWorld’s clear, deterministic task-completion signal, so it does not transfer as-is to domains with ambiguous or absent completion signals.
